critical_code_review_comments: Plan enforcement implementation is correct and complete
Backend properly checks limits before creating vehicles/users and returns 403 with descriptive error messages
Frontend correctly fetches plan data via /api/my-plan and displays usage indicators
Frontend buttons are properly disabled with visual feedback (gray background, cursor-not-allowed)
Toast notifications are triggered when attempting to add vehicle/user at limit
Legacy plan names (starter, basic, pro) are correctly mapped to new 3-tier plans (standard, essential, professional)
seed_data_creation: Temporarily modified Bumbleance tenant limits (max_vehicles=5, max_users=4) to test limit enforcement, then restored to original values (max_vehicles=10, max_users=20)
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-tier subscription plan enforcement feature fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) GET /api/my-plan returns plan info, limits, usage, and features correctly. 2) POST /api/vehicles returns 403 with 'Vehicle limit reached' message when at limit. 3) POST /api/tenant/users returns 403 with 'User limit reached' message when at limit. 4) Frontend Admin page shows usage indicators (X/Y vehicles, X/Y users) that turn red at limit. 5) Add Car and Create User buttons are disabled with gray styling when at limit. 6) Toast notifications appear when clicking disabled buttons. Test database commands: db.tenants.updateOne({slug:'bumbleance'}, {$set: {max_vehicles: 5}}) to test vehicle limit.
